record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058> upon Sheminith<WH08067>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068>, rebuke<WH03198><WTH8686> me not in thine anger<WH0639>, neither chasten<WH03256><WTH8762> me in thy hot displeasure<WH02534>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>Sheminith: or, the eighth<Rf>
Have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, O LORD<WH03068>; for I <FI>am<Fi> weak<WH0536>: O LORD<WH03068>, heal<WH07495><WTH8798> me; for my bones<WH06106> are vexed<WH0926><WTH8738>.
My soul<WH05315> is also sore<WH03966> vexed<WH0926><WTH8738>: but thou, O LORD<WH03068>, how long?
Return<WH07725><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, deliver<WH02502><WTH8761> my soul<WH05315>: oh save<WH03467><WTH8685> me for thy mercies<WH02617>' sake.
For in death<WH04194> <FI>there is<Fi> no remembrance<WH02143> of thee: in the grave<WH07585> who shall give thee thanks<WH03034><WTH8686>?

I am weary<WH03021><WTH8804> with my groaning<WH0585>; all the night<WH03915> make I my bed<WH04296> to swim<WH07811><WTH8686>; I water<WH04529><WTH8686> my couch<WH06210> with my tears<WH01832>. <RF>all...: or, every night<Rf>
Mine eye<WH05869> is consumed<WH06244><WTH8804> because of grief<WH03708>; it waxeth old<WH06275><WTH8804> because of all mine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>.<CM>
Depart<WH05493><WTH8798> from me, all ye workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>; for the LORD<WH03068> hath heard<WH08085><WTH8804> the voice<WH06963> of my weeping<WH01065>.
The LORD<WH03068> hath heard<WH08085><WTH8804> my supplication<WH08467>; the LORD<WH03068> will receive<WH03947><WTH8799> my prayer<WH08605>.

Let all mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> and sore<WH03966> vexed<WH0926><WTH8735>: let them return<WH07725><WTH8799> <FI>and<Fi> be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> suddenly<WH07281>.<CM>
